title: Settings and privacy
deviceNote: These four settings are saved on this device only.
lowBandwidthHint: No animation and no downloaded fonts. Turns on by itself on slow connections.
languageHint: Translations other than English are placeholders waiting for review by fluent speakers.
displayNameHint: Shown to you, and to a trusted contact if you choose to share.
timezoneHint: Used to work out which day a check-in belongs to.
exportHint: Everything held about you, as one file.
consentHistoryHint: Every time you agreed to or withdrew something.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.removed: Deleted for good: your account, check-ins, episodes, triggers, exercise feedback, safety plan, trusted contacts, consents and delivery records.
delete.kept: Kept for up to 12 months, with nothing that identifies you: a record that consents were given or withdrawn and that an account was deleted.
delete.contacts: Your trusted contacts are not told.
